name: Chamba
shortFact: A reservoir of ancient stone architecture.
description: Chamba is an untouched paradise that has preserved its artistic heritage and medieval temples for over a thousand years.
history: Chamba is unique for its well-documented history since 500 A.D., protected by its remote mountain ranges. The ruling family was founded by Raja Maru around 550 A.D., with the original capital at Brahampura (Bharmour). In 920 A.D., Raja Sahil Varman shifted the capital to Chamba town, naming it after his daughter, Champavati. The Laxmi Narayan temple complex stands as a witness to this glorious era. Chamba safely preserved its Pahari culture and exquisite stone architecture even during the peak of external invasions in northern India. It merged with the Indian Union in April 1948.
culture: The 'Chamba Rumal', world-renowned for its 'Dorukha' (double-sided) silk embroidery, is a symbol of Chamba's artistic excellence. The 'Minjar Mela' is a unique harvest festival where silken tassels are offered to the Ravi River. Chamba shoes (Chappals) are G.I. tagged for their unique craftsmanship. Folk songs like 'Musaddi' and traditional dances reflect the emotional depth of its people, who still preserve ancient stone-carving techniques.

topSpots.name: Khajjiar Lake
topSpots.description: Commonly known as the 'Mini Switzerland of India', featuring a floating island and cedar forests.

topSpots.name: Choughan Ground
topSpots.description: The social and cultural heart of Chamba, where the Minjar Mela is celebrated annually.

topSpots.name: Lakshmi Narayan Temple
topSpots.description: A 10th-century temple complex built by Sahil Varman, showcasing Shikhara style architecture.

topSpots.name: Mani Mahesh Lake
topSpots.description: A high-altitude pilgrimage site located at the foot of the sacred Mani Mahesh Kailash peak.

cuisine.name: Chamba Madra
cuisine.description: Slow-cooked Rajma (kidney beans) in a rich yogurt and local spice gravy.
cuisine.history: Madra is the soul of Chamba's culinary identity, dating back to the princely era of the Chamba state.
cuisine.tip: Best paired with steamed Basmati rice and a side of Khatta (tangy pumpkin dish).

wildlife.name: Himalayan Ibex
wildlife.description: A sturdy mountain goat known for its large curved horns, found in the high cliffs of the Pangi valley.

weather.monsoon_impact: Moderate rainfall, misty landscapes, landslides possible on high passes
weather.packing_essentials: Light cottons for summer, heavy woolens for winter snowfall visits

festivals.name: Minjar Mela
festivals.description: An international harvest festival marked by cultural processions and silken tassels.

festivals.name: Suhi Mata Mela
festivals.description: A fair dedicated to the sacrifice of Queen Sunayana for the town's water supply.

itineraries.title: The Antique Hills
itineraries.description: A journey through time in the medieval town of Chamba and the alpine meadows of Khajjiar.

days.title: Chamba Town Heritage
days.description: Explore the ancient temples of Chamba town and the Bhuri Singh Museum which houses rare Pahari paintings.

days.title: Mini Switzerland
days.description: Drive to Khajjiar, often called the Mini Switzerland of India, for a day of nature and picnics.

days.title: Temple Trail
days.description: Visit the beautiful Chamera Lake for boating before heading back.
